en: Yesterday: a pen and a notebook cost one pound ten. The notebook costs one pound more than the pen.
Most people say ten pence. But then the notebook is one pound ten, and the total is one pound twenty!
So the pen costs five pence. The notebook, one pound and five pence. Together: one pound ten!
Person one opens a hand. Two coins. Together, they make thirty pence.
Person two looks closely and says: one of them is not a ten pence coin.
Person three shouts: that is impossible! ... Or is it?
So, which two coins does Person one have?
Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
